claims: C1 the assistant must not create content that praises an extremist agenda that promotes violence
C2 the assistant must not create content that endorses an extremist agenda that promotes violence
C3 the assistant must not create content that aids an extremist agenda that promotes violence

C4 the qualifier binds the shared object: the prohibition reaches only those extremist agendas that promote violence, and content about an extremist agenda that does not promote violence is left unaddressed by this clause rather than permitted by it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction carrying the root authority level, the level the instructions of the section on avoiding extremist content are set at

concepts.name: violent_extremist_agenda
concepts.gloss: A is an extremist agenda of the kind this clause reaches: one that promotes violence, as opposed to an extremist agenda that does not

concepts.name: extremist_agenda
concepts.gloss: A is a programme of aims pursued well outside accepted political or social bounds; whether it also promotes violence is a separate fact about it

concepts.name: promotes_violence
concepts.gloss: A is an agenda that promotes violence, rather than merely holding a position outside the mainstream

concepts.name: praises
concepts.gloss: argument order is content then agenda: the piece of content C speaks well of the agenda A, treating it favourably

concepts.name: endorses
concepts.gloss: argument order is content then agenda: the piece of content C gives the agenda A its backing or approval rather than merely describing it

concepts.name: aids
concepts.gloss: argument order is content then agenda: the piece of content C helps the agenda A along, furthering what it is trying to achieve

ontology.gloss: an extremist agenda that promotes violence, which is the only kind of extremist agenda this clause's prohibition reaches

asserts.read_back: the assistant must not create content %, because it praises extremist agenda %, which promotes violence
the assistant must not create content %, because it endorses extremist agenda %, which promotes violence
the assistant must not create content %, because it aids extremist agenda %, which promotes violence

closure.reason: the clause states only that content praising, endorsing or aiding violent extremist agendas must not be created, and says nothing at all about creating any other content, so it does not settle what its own silence means for the rest
